text:
jasper: Hey team — first day. Using an M1 Pro. I prefer fish, have asdf for node/python, Homebrew in /opt/homebrew, and our repo has a devcontainer that defaults to bash. After spinning up the container my PATH and ssh-agent don't match my host. Any quick recommended pattern?

meera: welcome! :wave: two quick patterns: 1) Make devcontainer source a shared env file that both shells read (e.g., /workspaces/.dev-env). 2) forward SSH agent into the container instead of re-adding keys. In devcontainer.json set "runArgs": ["-v","$SSH_AUTH_SOCK:$SSH_AUTH_SOCK","-e","SSH_AUTH_SOCK"] and in Dockerfile ensure the socket path exists.

noah: also for fish users: if your devcontainer uses bash, add a small shim ~ /workspaces/.dev-env that exports PATH/LDFLAGS and then source it from fish with `source ~/.dev-env; set -x PATH $PATH` so both shells see same env.

jasper: I tried SSH forwarding and `ssh-add -l` inside container still shows no keys. Did volume mount wrong?

meera: common mistake is using $SSH_AUTH_SOCK on host but the container path differs. Use the exact host socket path when mounting. Check `echo $SSH_AUTH_SOCK` on host and `ls -l` after mount. Also ensure the container user has permissions for the socket (match uid/gid or use a group).

dev-tools-bot: Reminder: we have a devcontainer template at https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-templates/devcontainer-ssh-forward that includes examples for fish and agent forwarding.

jasper: got it — mounting the socket using the full host path fixed ssh agent. One last: node-gyp build inside container fails due to openssl not found. What's the minimal workaround?

noah: install brew libs in the container (apt on linux images) or build using an image that already includes /opt/homebrew libs. Another trick: set PKG_CONFIG_PATH and LDFLAGS inside the container to point at the distro's openssl dev package locations before building.

dotfiles-bot: If you update any snippets, please open a micro-PR to https://github.com/redwood-inference/dotfiles under devcontainers/ with the template.

jasper: thanks everyone — pairing with @meera briefly after standup to tidy my devcontainer.json and I'll PR the env snippet. Appreciate the help!
